specification: Jaffe-Witten Quantum Yang-Mills Theory: compact simple G, nontrivial quantum Yang-Mills on R^4, mass gap Delta>0, axiomatic properties at least as strong as cited.
proof_regulator: L2(G) compact-group lattice gauge theory with Wilson/heat-kernel transfer structure
finite_computational_bridge: Peter-Weyl SU(3) truncations plus separate 20D quantum-link stress workbench

peter_weyl.truncation_statement: H_K = direct_sum_{p+q<=K} V_(p,q) tensor V_(p,q)^*. Peter-Weyl gives closure union_K H_K dense in L2(SU3), hence P_K -> I strongly.
peter_weyl.electric_statement: -Delta_SU3 is diagonal on each Peter-Weyl block with eigenvalue C2(p,q), so the first nonzero electric eigenvalue is C_F=4/3.
peter_weyl.wilson_multiplication_statement: Multiplication by a fundamental matrix coefficient maps irrep (p,q) into (p,q) tensor (1,0); projected finite matrices converge strongly on the algebraic Peter-Weyl core because every finite core vector is eventually interior to the cutoff.

heat_kernel.general_positive_type_identity: sum_ij c_i^* c_j K_t(g_i^-1 g_j) = sum_lambda d_lambda exp(-t C2(lambda)) ||sum_i c_i pi_lambda(g_i)||_HS^2 >= 0
heat_kernel.convolution_semigroup: Fourier coefficient of K_t * K_s is exp(-(t+s)C2(lambda)); hence K_t*K_s=K_(t+s).

proof_graph.definition_of_completion: All primary lemmas on the critical path are promoted to proved theorems with constants independent of regulator and volume; then JW-10/11/12 follow.

completion_rule: All primary lemmas in proof_graph.critical_path must be discharged with regulator- and volume-independent constants; dependent conclusions then follow by the stated theorems.
